items.quote: Direct reports said that Wenko drove steadying a team facing adversity for the whole division.
They championed the crisis response to a major system outage and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Wenko Tamason led the five-year strategic plan for the division across the department.
Peers observed that Wenko Tamason spearheaded cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce at the national level.
Peers observed that Wenko Tamason handled the digital redesign of the permit system competently within their team.
Direct reports said that Wenko delivered their share of media interviews and press conferences reliably.
Several respondents noted that Wenko took ownership of analytics to guide resource allocation and steered it to completion.
Wenko set the direction for negotiations with contractors on the service agreement across the public service.
Direct reports said that Wenko took ownership of stakeholder consultations for the licensing review and steered it to completion.
